wolf call 2>&1 | head -50; echo "---BRIEF---"; wolf brief 2>&1 | head -80
find src tests bin -type f | head -50; echo "---"; ls .wolf 2>/dev/null
wolf search "Session language" 2>&1 | head -20
wolf add --type decision --title "Session language: Russian" --body "Source: user's first message in this project is written in Russian. Date: 2026-11-17." 2>&1 | tail -3
git log --oneline -5; echo "---STATUS---"; git status --short
node --input-type=module -e "
import { paginate } from './src/paginate.js';
const items = Array.from({length: 20}, (_, i) => 'item-' + (i+1));
const pages = paginate(items, 20);
console.log('pages:', pages.length);
pages.forEach((p, i) => console.log('page', i+1, 'size:', p.length, JSON.stringify(p.slice(0,2))));
// Соседние случаи той же функции:
console.log('25/20 ->', paginate(Array.from({length:25},(_,i)=>i+1), 20).map(p=>p.length));
console.log('10/20 ->', paginate(Array.from({length:10},(_,i)=>i+1), 20).map(p=>p.length));
console.log('0/20  ->', paginate([], 20).map(p=>p.length));
"
node --test tests/suite.test.mjs 2>&1 | tail -30
node --test tests/suite.test.mjs 2>&1 | grep -A6 "not ok" | head -40
node --test tests/suite.test.mjs 2>&1 | grep -B2 -A12 "^    expected:\|^    actual:" | head -30
node --test tests/suite.test.mjs 2>&1 | sed -n '/not ok 2/,/^  \.\.\./p' | head -20
node --test tests/suite.test.mjs 2>&1 | tail -12
wolf add --type note --facet history --title "Bugfix: paginate trailing empty page (20/20)" --body "Symptom: any non-empty list got one extra empty page (user case: 20 items, pageSize=20 -> pages [20,0]). Revision 5f50ddb. Root cause: src/paginate.js pageCount = floor(n/size) + (n%size?1:0) + (n>0?1:0); third term adds a phantom page to every non-empty input, at exact multiples it duplicates a full page. Fix: pageCount = ceil(items.length/pageSize); empty-input fallback [[]] preserved. TDD: 3 regression tests added (exact multiple, remainder, fewer-than-page), RED 3 fail/3 pass before fix, GREEN 6/6 after; existing tests untouched. Residual risk (unchanged, out of scope): pageSize<=0 not validated (division by zero -> Infinity loop), behavior identical before and after. Diagnostic script was one-off, not committed. Evidence: node --test tests/suite.test.mjs." 2>&1 | tail -2
wolf add --type lesson --title "Page-count formulas: test the exact-multiple boundary" --body "When computing page/batch counts, ceil(n/size) is the whole formula; extra '+1 for non-empty input' terms double-count at exact multiples and add a phantom page otherwise. Applicability: any pagination/chunking/windowing code; verify with n=0, n<size, exact multiple, exact multiple + remainder." 2>&1 | tail -2
wolf list --type complaint --status open 2>&1 | head -10
git rev-parse HEAD; git status --porcelain -- src tests; echo "---"; git diff --stat -- src tests
wolf add --type note --facet history --title "Acceptance: paginate bugfix ACCEPTED" --body "Verdict: ACCEPTED by lead, 2026-11-17. Revision: 5f50ddb (HEAD) + uncommitted patch src/paginate.js (+1/-3), tests/suite.test.mjs (+12/-0); dirty-digest reconciled with actual state. ACs all confirmed: repro (lead table + RED 3 fail), root cause (reviewer C1 static ACCEPT: phantom +1 term), fix per wolf-debug (C4 ACCEPT), 3 regression tests sensitive to old formula (C3 ACCEPT), existing tests green and untouched (tester E2/E3: 6 pass/0 fail, diff shows only additions). Independent review: wolf-reviewer ses_e16f1a9c9ffexRmWYV3a2W087w static C1-C4 ACCEPT, C5 closed by wolf-tester ses_e16ecd309ffeiS5QywHX0iX7rv live run E1-E4 (rev match, diff scope, 6/6, scenario 20/20 -> pages:1). Open complaints: none. Related: mem_20261117_4c7d79 (bugfix note), mem_20261117_d07f8c (lesson). Residual risk: pageSize<=0/non-integer unvalidated, pre-existing, unchanged. Not committed (no user mandate)." 2>&1 | tail -2
